title: Surreal AI Oracle
description: A surreal scene featuring a golden robotic female figure with exposed mechanical parts and puzzle-piece armor, holding a paper while a small blue alien-like being clings to her back. In the desert landscape, three silver humanoid statues stand near a winding path leading to a massive swirling vortex in the sky, from which a rainbow waterfall pours down. A cloaked wizard figure floats within a purple portal above, while a beetle in a glass orb and floating letter tiles populate the scene.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with a golden mechanical female android covered in puzzle pieces and lotus details, holding an ancient paper, a small blue alien attached to her back. Three shiny silver female statues stand on the left. A giant swirling red and orange vortex in the starry sky contains a purple portal with a cloaked wizard figure. A rainbow waterfall flows from the vortex into the desert. A glass orb with a beetle on a tornado base floats to the right, along with scattered letter tiles and puzzle pieces.
